production.start: fresh initial cellspace, not continuation of the historical condition2 N1 run

coupling: Within each condition, all 512 trial IDs use independent counter RNG streams. Conditions deliberately share seed and trial IDs for paired comparisons; do not pool them as 1536 independent repetitions of one problem.

preflight.time_projection: Slowest 8-GPU pilot rank elapsed/20000 x 3000000, with a separate 10% margin estimate. A short pilot is not a 24h completion guarantee.

schedule: All production jobs depend on successful preflight. condition1_N2 also waits for condition1_N1 to end; condition2_N2 waits for condition1_N2 to end. No more than 8 GPUs run at a time. If one production condition times out, independent later conditions may still run. Incomplete jobs fail the completion check and retain restart checkpoints.
scientific_limitations: Short GPU activity/parity tests do not certify long-run solution search or full FSM recovery.
Read solutions from stable FSM x1..x6 output; a reset or F output is not an optimality declaration.
The historical condition2 N1 map has initial Weights [4,4,5,1,1,1] but reset gains [4,3,2,1,5,5]. It is not a matched control for the corrected condition2 N2 map.
